{"CommandLine":"git add src/AsyncImageProvider.cpp test_scrollbench/src/FastImageItem.cpp test_scrollbench/qml/AlbumsViewScrollBench.qml; git commit -m "fix: resolve critical C++ use-after-free and race conditions during rapid thumbnail resizing

1. Fixed Use-After-Free in AsyncImageProvider: `AsyncImageResponse::handleDone` was queueing a lambda to the global `s_frameScheduler` that captured `this` as a raw pointer. If `deleteLater()` destroyed the response before the GUI thread executed the lambda, it crashed accessing `this->m_image`. It now captures `QPointer<AsyncImageResponse>`.
2. Fixed Race Condition in FastImageItem: The lambda for `finished()` blindly processed `m_response` without verifying the sender. If an old, cancelled response emitted `finished()`, it would mistakenly read from and delete the NEW `m_response` instance, breaking the loading pipeline. It now strictly verifies `m_response == response`.
